prompts.display_text: Pin a country whose second dedicated temple was dedicated between 1987 and 2000.
prompts.text_original: Pin a country whose second dedicated temple was dedicated between 1987 and 2000.
prompts.citation: ChurchofJesusChristTemples.org chronology and milestones, read 27 Oct 2026
prompts.summary: A country's second temple, counting only temples now in operation, usually means the Church there has outgrown one temple. Germany's second, in Frankfurt, was dedicated on 28 August 1987, the earliest in this set.

answers.name: Germany
answers.fact: Frankfurt Germany (28 August 1987); Freiberg, dedicated in 1985 in then East Germany, was the first.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country holding a place named in Zechariah 9, from Damascus and Tyre to Gaza and Greece
prompts.text_original: A present-day country holding a place named in Zechariah 9 (Hadrach, Damascus, Hamath, Tyre, Zidon, the Philistine cities, Greece)
prompts.summary: Zechariah 9 opens with a burden on Damascus and Hamath in Syria, on Tyre and Zidon, and on the Philistine cities of Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron and Ashdod. The same chapter foretells the king coming lowly on an ass and names Greece, by its Hebrew name Javan, as a foe Judah will overcome.

answers.name: Israel
answers.fact: Ashkelon, Ekron and Ashdod are Philistine cities in Israel (Zechariah 9:5-6).

answers.name: Lebanon
answers.fact: Tyrus and Zidon are named, and Tyre will be devoured with fire (Zechariah 9:2-4).

answers.name: Syria
answers.fact: The burden falls on Damascus, and Hamath borders it (Zechariah 9:1-2).

answers.name: Greece
answers.fact: The Lord will raise Zion's sons against thy sons, O Greece (Zechariah 9:13).

prompts.display_text: Pin a country where two or more new temples were dedicated from 2016 through October 2026.
prompts.text_original: A country where two or more new temples were dedicated from 2016 through October 2026 (rededications not counted).
prompts.citation: ChurchofJesusChristTemples.org chronology (dedicated, under construction, announced), read 27 Oct 2026
prompts.summary: Since 2016 the countries dedicating two or more new temples are the United States, Brazil, the Philippines, Argentina, Peru, Guatemala, Chile and Japan. Mexico does not qualify: Tijuana was dedicated in December 2015 and Puebla in 2024 is its only new temple since. Canada, Colombia, Ecuador and Honduras each added just one.

answers.name: Brazil
answers.fact: Fortaleza 2019, Belém and Rio de Janeiro 2022, Brasília 2023, Salvador 2024, Belo Horizonte 2026.

prompts.display_text: Pin a West African country where the Church has at least one stake as of October 2026.
prompts.text_original: A West African country where the Church has at least one stake as of October 2026.
prompts.citation: Church facts and statistics country pages (figures of 31 Dec 2025), read 4 Nov 2026
prompts.summary: Eight West African countries have stakes: Nigeria (80), Ghana (31), Ivory Coast (23), Sierra Leone (11), Liberia (7), Cape Verde (4), Togo (3) and Benin (2). The work is young in the region's French-speaking Sahel: Senegal, Mali, Guinea and Burkina Faso have only small branches.

prompts.display_text: Pin a Western or Southern European country dedicated or rededicated for the preaching of the gospel between 1966 and 1998.
prompts.text_original: A Western or Southern European country that a Church leader dedicated or rededicated for the preaching of the gospel between 1966 and 1998.
prompts.citation: Global Histories chronologies: Italy, Austria, Netherlands, Belgium, Iceland, Ireland, Denmark; Church News (Spain 2009, Greece 1999); Global Histories Portugal overview
prompts.summary: Southern Europe opened to full-time missionaries in the 1960s and 1970s: Italy was rededicated in 1966, Spain dedicated in 1969, Greece in 1972 and Portugal in 1975. Later apostolic prayers covered Iceland (1977), Ireland (1985), Austria and the Netherlands (1992), and rededications of Belgium and Denmark (1998). Yugoslavia (1985) is not a single modern country.

answers.name: Spain
answers.fact: Marion G. Romney dedicated Spain from a hill in Casa de Campo, Madrid, in 1969.

answers.name: Italy
answers.fact: Rededicated at Torre Pellice on November 10, 1966, after the Italian Mission was organized.

answers.name: Portugal
answers.fact: Thomas S. Monson dedicated Portugal near the Sintra Mountains in 1975.

answers.name: Austria
answers.fact: Howard W. Hunter dedicated Austria from the Kahlenberg above Vienna on September 12, 1992.

answers.name: Belgium
answers.fact: Jeffrey R. Holland rededicated Belgium at Tervuren on May 26, 1998.

answers.name: Ireland
answers.fact: Neal A. Maxwell dedicated Ireland on October 23, 1985, near the site of the first baptism of 1840.

answers.name: Iceland
answers.fact: Joseph B. Wirthlin dedicated Iceland from Oskjuhlid in Reykjavik on September 18, 1977.

answers.name: Netherlands
answers.fact: L. Tom Perry dedicated the Netherlands on September 10, 1992.

answers.name: Denmark
answers.fact: Thomas S. Monson rededicated Denmark for the preaching of the gospel in 1998.

answers.name: Greece
answers.fact: Gordon B. Hinckley dedicated Greece for the preaching of the gospel in 1972.
